title: Expense Reimbursement Approval Form
subtitle: Use this approval to test evidence and authority, resolve conflicts, issue a bounded decision, and verify every resulting update for a expense reimbursement workflow.
description: An original operational expense reimbursement approval form that controls a employee business-expense claim and substantiation record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the employee claimant, manager, or expense processor needs a traceable approval so the authorized manager, finance, payroll, tax, or compliance reviewer can reimburse, partially reimburse, return, deny, recode, offset an advance, or escalate the claim under the current expense policy, approval limits, receipt and substantiation rules, project coding, and applicable tax requirements without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement approval submission and authority route
sections.guidance: Identify the proposed action, submitter, decision authority, effective point, and required evidence.

blocks.label: Expense Reimbursement identity
Approval ownership and routing
Approval control
Proposed action, purpose, exact scope, affected people or work, exclusions, and requested conditions

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement evidence completeness and readiness
sections.guidance: Reject unsupported assumptions before the decision reaches an approver.

blocks.label: Expense Reimbursement approval readiness
items: Business purpose and connection are specific and supported
Every line is substantiated under the applicable policy
Duplicate, personal, refunded, and card-paid amounts are excluded
Advance and excess reimbursement are fully reconciled
Cost center, project, client, grant, and tax coding are valid
Exception approver has authority and no self-approval conflict
Approved total equals the sum of line-item dispositions
Payment and retention owners can complete the authorized outcome

blocks.label: Evidence package submitted
items: Expense report and claimant certification
Itemized receipt, invoice, ticket, or permitted alternate evidence
Mileage route, travel itinerary, or attendance support
Preapproval and policy-exception decision
Corporate-card transaction and cash-advance record
Currency-conversion, refund, credit, or allocation evidence
Manager, finance, tax, payroll, or grant review
Payment, amount-returned, recovery, or corrected-claim reference

blocks.label: Required item, evidence, owner, status, and deficiency

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement policy, authority, and impact review
sections.guidance: Apply the current decision standard and record each reviewer within their actual authority.

blocks.label: Expense Reimbursement policy and impact checks
items: Expense has a documented business connection and claimant
Date, merchant, location, amount, currency, and category reconcile
Receipt or permitted alternate evidence supports the amount
Business purpose identifies the work objective rather than a generic label
Attendees, mileage route, allocation, or other category detail is complete
Duplicate, personal, companion, refunded, and card-paid amounts are excluded
Policy limit, preapproval, timing, and exception requirements were reviewed
Advance, reimbursement, and amount owed back are correctly reconciled
Project, cost center, client, grant, and tax coding have an owner
Decision distinguishes allowed, reduced, returned, and denied line items

blocks.label: Review area, reviewer, authority, evidence, finding, and condition
People, schedule, service, cost, payroll, privacy, security, safety, consistency, and system impacts

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement conflicts, exceptions, and approval conditions
sections.guidance: Resolve material conflicts and convert every condition into owned, verifiable work.

blocks.label: Approval stop and escalation boundary
blocks.guidance: Pause any action outside documented authority. Protect privacy, preserve the original evidence, and route urgent, safety, security, retaliation, or legal concerns to the authorized manager, finance, payroll, tax, or compliance reviewer under the current expense policy, approval limits, receipt and substantiation rules, project coding, and applicable tax requirements.

blocks.label: Expense Reimbursement exception and escalation triggers
items: Duplicate claim or prior payment was discovered
Receipt, amount, merchant, currency, or claimant identity is inconsistent
Corporate-card charge was also submitted as personal payment
Refund, credit, cancellation, or unused ticket was not reflected
Personal, companion, or otherwise excluded amount was included
Payment was sent to the wrong person, account, amount, or currency
Expense evidence exposed payment data beyond the required record
Suspected alteration, misrepresentation, policy circumvention, or retaliation arose

blocks.label: Exception, immediate action, owner, due point, and disposition register
Exception facts, affected scope, privacy boundary, unresolved risk, and escalation rationale
Approval condition, prerequisite, owner, due point, evidence, and expiry

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement approval decision and effective boundary
sections.guidance: Record one unambiguous decision with rationale, authority, conditions, and review date.

blocks.label: Approval boundary
blocks.guidance: Approval is valid only within the stated scope and authority. The authorized manager, finance, payroll, tax, or compliance reviewer must apply the current expense policy, approval limits, receipt and substantiation rules, project coding, and applicable tax requirements; a signature does not override a required privacy, safety, security, legal, payroll, tax, or accommodation review.

blocks.label: Approval decision
Evidence relied upon, contrary evidence, alternatives, conditions, limits, and reason for decision
Submission, qualified review, and decision authorization

fields.label: Authorized Manager, Finance, Payroll, Tax, Or Compliance Reviewer / date

sections.title: Expense Reimbursement implementation, notification, and approval closeout
sections.guidance: Verify that the approved outcome reached every affected system and recipient.

blocks.label: Approved implementation, system update, notification, and verification
Approval outcome and handoff
Open expense reimbursement action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
Approval accountable review

fields.label: Authorized Manager, Finance, Payroll, Tax, Or Compliance Reviewer / date
